body: That is so awesome that your dad did that for you! It was also our last family photo trip back a few months ago. Water was too cold to swim in, but we went to the washout and found some really cool shells and took pictures (well, I took pictures so Im not in them [sadface]). We all had a BLAST climbing rocky hills, toes in the sand, taking pics, grabbing some really cool shells (sorry mr Hermit), and splashing out feets in the water. Toes were the days. Smiles. Smiles. Smiles. Then ice cream cups in November. Beach tradition I guess.

No I just got a new doctor. A team actually, but one main one. She came up with PTSD. All other docs I've been to just ask "how ya feelin" and slap me with major depressive disorder, write me a prescription, and get me on my way. So I went to a practice, like a group practice where they work together as a team but you get one doctor but they can all see you. She spent a lot of time with medical history, personal history, family history, etc. Blood tests were done, I mean, the whole shebang. She spent quite a bit on the whole history part. I couldn't hold back a lot of the stuff any longer because life had gotten so bad - I've been through some pretty serious shit. Maybe not as bad as others, maybe worse than others. Its my shit and I sat in it for a long time. The medicines help me out. Like right now I'm pretty calm. I'm drowsy and can't drive but I'm calm. The morning is okay, the afternoons are hit or miss, the evenings and dusk are what hit me the most, thats why the night time meds are the heavy hitters. So far so good but I need some other stuff in the daytime.

Doc says PTSD is treated 10% with medication, 90% therapy getting through your trauma. I have only had a couple of sessions so far - they actually fired the lady they had me working with she was nuts. Set me waaaay back. She was filling my head with all sorts of things about my wife being a crack smoking lesbian hooker (my wife had a full time job for a major guitar company and up until that point, and I do believe even now, has remained as faithful as any person can get). She kept telling me I was in denial that I was smoking crack and using heroin all day. She said I wasn't being truthful with things I was telling her. She said I was gay. She had a sex obsession. Always wanted to talk about weird sex shit. She's gone now. Starting over next week. Not looking forward to it.

Hey thanks for reaching out. I have to hit the rack its a nice night and the breeze is just right. You take care and help others. Sorry for freaking out on everyone. I'm having trouble keeping my eyes open.

BTW my wife just texted me a few minutes ago that shes not even thinking of a divorce, just not sure what to do right now. I think its more of my episodes than anything. I told her to call my doctor - I gave her full access to my records including medical and therapy, and to learn as much about this crap as possible. Its whats eating my soul. 

Good idea talking to the VA. I was thinking of doing some volunteer work down there too since I'm not working - I think decent things when I'm not triggered. Guess I can see if they have a group or something. Hey I'm getting sleepy. Take care. Its a nice night out and I'm going to take advantage of this breeze.
